correctness.rationale: C PASS: The full cyclic action on undirected K_n edges has precisely one orbit E_d for each chord distance 1<=d<=floor(n/2), and each dihedral reflection preserves E_d. Equal barycentric orbit masses therefore give equality—not just homotopy equivalence—of geometric C_n and D_n fixed sets. The union circulant G(n,S) is connected iff gcd(n,S)=1. For |S|>=2 its degree >=3 including the even antipodal edge case, and Watkins's connected vertex-transitive bound kappa>=2(degree+1)/3 makes it 3-vertex-connected; a coprime singleton is an ordinary cycle, not 3-connected. Hence fixed faces consist of gcd(n,S)>1 sets plus isolated coprime singleton distances. Cover the nonunit subcomplex by simplices for each prime p dividing n; all nonempty intersections are simplices with witness distance product of primes <=n/2. Its nerve is S^{omega(n)-2} for squarefree composite n and contractible for nonsquarefree composites; for primes it is empty. Adding phi(n)/2 isolated unit distances gives all claimed integral homology and n=30 first multi-degree H0=Z^4,H1=Z. An independent graph adjacency/reachability check enumerated all distance subsets n=4..11 and all deletions of <=2 vertices; this corroborates but does not prove general Watkins/nerve statements.
